title: RouterOS — Digested OS for Gaia Learning

key_features: L2/L3 switching with VLAN, spanning tree, bonding
Built-in firewall, NAT, VPN (IPsec, L2TP, PPTP, SSTP, WireGuard)
gaia_lessons: Binary API protocol: length-encoded words in sentences
Authentication: MD5 challenge-response (old) or plain login (v6.43+)
Default credentials: admin with empty password
Factory reset: hold reset 5+ seconds during boot
RouterOS v7 supports Docker containers — could run biomeOS!
MAC-telnet: reach device even without IP config

digestible_for_gaia.network_monitoring: Port mirror, traffic flow, SNMP, NetFlow/sFlow
digestible_for_gaia.api_integration: Binary API + REST API = full programmable control
digestible_for_gaia.container_support: RouterOS v7 can run Docker = run Gaia primals directly
digestible_for_gaia.l2_visibility: MAC address table, port statistics, STP state
digestible_for_gaia.gaia_vision: MikroTik becomes Gaia's L2 nervous system sensor
